steps.summary: Set the top-bar refresh picker to '1m' on 'fwgr31-n2 Bench Dashboard'. The picker change alone did not mark the dashboard dirty (the Save dashboard dialog said "No changes to save"), so I entered edit mode (Edit), opened Save dashboard, ticked the "Update default refresh value – Will make the current refresh the new default" checkbox (which registered "Changes 1" and enabled Save) — the "Update default time range" checkbox was not offered because the current 6-hour range already equalled the saved default — and clicked Save, which confirmed with the "Dashboard saved" alert and closed edit mode. Verified persistence by reloading the bare URL /d/bfy6g8hcxk3k0c/fwgr31-n2-bench-dashboard with no query params: the refresh control shows '1m' and the time picker shows 'Last 6 hours' (Grafana re-added from=now-6h&refresh=1m from the saved defaults). The replay's failed step 4 (ticking "Update default refresh value") was completed manually.
